town.label: Town
town.win: Wins when every Mafia member is gone.

mafia.label: Mafia
mafia.win: Wins when the Mafia equal or outnumber everyone else.

independent.label: Independent
independent.win: This pack sets no win condition for independents; the host decides it.

bomb.text: Their night killer dies with them

miller.text: Reads as Scum to alignment checks

godfather.text: Reads as Town to alignment checks

town_ita_shooter.name: ITA Shooter
town_ita_shooter.summary: During the day, may take shots in ITA sessions at an ordinary hit chance.

town_ita_sharpshooter.name: ITA Sharpshooter
town_ita_sharpshooter.summary: During the day, may take shots in ITA sessions at a better hit chance.

town_ita_bad_shot.name: ITA Bad Shot
town_ita_bad_shot.summary: During the day, may take shots in ITA sessions at a worse hit chance.

town_vanilla.name: Vanilla Townie
town_vanilla.summary: No special power. Wins with the Town through discussion and the vote.

vanilla_town.name: Vanilla Town
vanilla_town.summary: No special power. Wins with the Town through discussion and the vote.

blank_town_role.name: Blank Town Role
blank_town_role.summary: A Town placeholder with no abilities, filled in by the host.

blank_mafia_role.name: Blank Mafia Role
blank_mafia_role.summary: A Mafia placeholder with no abilities, filled in by the host.

lover.name: Lover
lover.summary: Bound to another Lover. If either dies, by any means, so does the other.
lover.win: Lives and dies with their partner; the host's setup decides how they win.

mafia_bomber.name: Mafia Bomber
mafia_bomber.summary: A Mafia member who takes their night killer down with them.

town_bomber.name: Town Bomber
town_bomber.summary: A Townie who takes their night killer down with them.

mason.name: Mason
mason.summary: Shares a private chat whose members are confirmed Town to each other.

neighbor.name: Neighbor
neighbor.summary: Shares a private chat, but its members learn nothing about each other's alignment.
neighbor.win: Has no alignment of their own; the host's setup decides how they win.

town_treestump.name: Town Treestump
town_treestump.summary: After elimination, may keep posting in the thread but cannot vote.

mafia_treestump.name: Mafia Treestump
mafia_treestump.summary: After elimination, may keep posting in the thread but cannot vote.

mafia_goon.name: Mafia Goon
mafia_goon.summary: A Mafia member with no power of their own, who may carry the factional kill.

mafia_roleblocker.name: Mafia Roleblocker
mafia_roleblocker.summary: Each night, blocks one player so their next blockable action fails.

mafia_jack_of_all_trades.name: Mafia Jack of All Trades
mafia_jack_of_all_trades.summary: Holds four one-shot powers: an alignment check, a protection, a block and a track.

town_doctor.name: Doctor

town_bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
town_bodyguard.summary: Each night, guards one player and dies stopping a kill aimed at them.
